title: Agent handoff report
description: Written by every agent before it exits, to $TASK_DIR/reports/<stage>-<role|subtask>.json. Absence of a valid report means the agent crashed.

subtask.description: Subtask id from plan.md, e.g. st-2-combat-hooks. Required for implement stage.

status.description: complete = did the job and verified it. blocked = cannot proceed, nothing further to try. escalate = needs a stronger model, a re-plan, or a human.

summary.description: One paragraph written FOR THE NEXT AGENT: what changed, what surprised you, what they must know. Not for humans, not a restatement of the task.

artifacts_written.description: Paths of every file created or modified: repo-relative for code, absolute (or $TASK_DIR-relative) for task artifacts.

deviations.description: Ids of entries appended to deviations.md during this session.

detail.description: What is wrong, citing an artifact and line where applicable.

evidence.description: Real command output or a concrete file reference. Never paraphrased or invented.

attempted.description: What you already tried and why it failed, so the next agent does not repeat it.

evidence.description: What you actually ran. Omit a field rather than guessing at it.

tests.description: Real result line, e.g. '214 passed, 0 failed'.

not_verified.description: Checks deliberately skipped, and why. Honesty here is required, not optional.

confidence.description: Advisory only. Never triggers escalation on its own, and never cancels an objective threshold.

role_data.description: Role-specific extras named by your role card (e.g. planner subtask_ids, test-author ac_coverage).
